population: Exactly the 206 IDs in the group-provided PSQ/fMRI/ECG list, matched against the 213-record main-session ECG screen

review_flags.candidate_intervals: any outside 300-2000 ms or successive ratio outside [0.5,2]
review_flags.trigger: median spacing differs from 1.4 s by >0.005 s

flags_are: Exploratory review prompts, not approved exclusion rules or validated signal-quality classifications
reanalysis: Filtering and aggregation of existing per-record results; no new signal processing or threshold changes
